description: Source-side slasher parity: reference's `slasher` is `path.posix.normalize(path.posix.join('/', value))` (glob-slash.js:6), so a source `../old` joins to `/../old`, normalizes to `/old`, then literal-matches request `/old`. Closes Codex round 2 P1 source-side gap. The earlier slice-1 `slasher` only prepended `/` and would have compiled this rule against `/../old`, which real requests never carry.
